description.value: Circle K is a 24-hour convenience store chain location in Vancouver's West End on Davie Street, a busy urban corridor. This location functions as both a petrol station and convenience store, offering snacks, fresh food, hot roller grill items, and coffee. Its around-the-clock availability makes it a reliable resupply stop for touring cyclists at any hour.
